name: jack-pockets-documentary
purpose: Improve the documentary agent harness without changing model weights or weakening editorial quality gates.

components.system_prompt: The Jack Pockets documentary pipeline: research first, evidence-led story planning, subject-specific visuals, restrained graphics, provenance, and strict quality gates.
guardrails: Never substitute unrelated footage just to fill a shot.
Never weaken relevance checks or quality gates to force a render.
Preserve source provenance and licensing metadata.
Prefer an intentional quality-gate failure over an irrelevant visual.
components.memory: public/runs and committed editorial configuration are the durable episode evidence; experimental branches are not part of the baseline.
tool_guidance: Use research sources for factual claims.
Use asset metadata and relevance scoring for visual selection.
Keep footage searches concise and subject-specific.
Validate final media with the existing quality gate and FFprobe checks.
